headline: Turkey and Singapore Sign Trade Protocol to Deepen Economic Ties
summary: Turkey and Singapore executed a Joint Economic and Trade Committee (JETCO) protocol to expand bilateral cooperation in trade, foreign investment, and industrial sectors.
why: Bilateral trade protocols facilitate cross-border capital flows between Southeast Asian financial hubs and Eurasian emerging markets.

impacts.name: Turkey
impacts.why: The JETCO agreement formalizes trade channel expansion and foreign direct investment avenues.
